This section describes the sample: who took part, in which classrooms, and
how complete the data are. Code: `code/si/S1_study_design.R`.

```{r s1-setup}
```

## Table S1. Classroom-level descriptive statistics

One row per classroom. Two computed ages above 15 years are birth-date
errors and are left out of the age summaries, as stated in the SI.

```{r s1-table-classrooms}
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(table_s1, digits = c(0, 0, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 2))
```

### Overall sample characteristics

The table summarizes the number of children, classrooms, and schools, as well as age and the percentage of girls in the sample.

```{r s1-sample-totals}
```

### Classroom composition by sex

The table counts mixed classrooms, classrooms with only girls, and classrooms with only boys.

```{r s1-classroom-composition}
```

## Table S2. Completeness

### Completeness by variable

The table reports the percentage of nonmissing values for each variable.

```{r s1-table-completeness}
```

### Coverage of directed game decisions

This check verifies whether each classroom has the expected $n(n-1)$ directed decisions.

```{r s1-decision-coverage}
```
